models.name: Qwen-Image-2512 Fun ControlNet Union (alibaba-pai)
models.commercial_notes: Apache-2.0 (Alibaba PAI Fun-line permissive license); base Qwen-Image-2512 is Apache-2.0 too, so the whole stack is commercial-safe for paid game assets — the same clean lane as the InstantX Qwen-Image-ControlNet-Union.
models.speed_note: Qwen-Image 20B base; each active control branch adds step cost. Quant (GGUF/Nunchaku) on 32GB; comfortable in bf16 on an 80GB cloud card.
models.summary: A commercial-safe (Apache-2.0) multi-condition ControlNet Union for the Qwen-Image-2512 base from Alibaba's PAI / VideoX-Fun team. An alternative to the InstantX Qwen-Image-ControlNet-Union (id 10) for stacking controls (e.g. canny + depth) in one model — directly useful for the studio's 3D pre-render RESTYLIZE, where the real TRELLIS mesh renders true canny + depth AOVs for free. IMPORTANT: depth + canny are the practical commercial-safe legs on the Qwen stack; there is NO commercial-safe NORMAL ControlNet for Qwen (normal only exists on the SDXL xinsir Union ProMax, id 11 — a model-family switch). Exact repo slug casing is 'Fun-Controlnet-Union' (lowercase n).

models.speed_note: Qwen-Image 20B base; in-context-control approach. Newer and less turnkey in ComfyUI than InstantX — verify node support before relying on it.
models.summary: An Apache-2.0 'in-context control' union for Qwen-Image from the DiffSynth-Studio (ModelScope) project — a second commercial-safe Qwen multi-condition control option alongside the InstantX (id 10) and alibaba-pai Fun (this wave) unions. Web-verified to exist; NOT yet measured on-rig and less turnkey in ComfyUI, so treat as situational until validated on the studio's restylize stack. Surfaced by the 2026-06-26 cloud-quality-levers research.
